component.name: Soyuz
component.summary: Keyboard-first file manager that never blocks

description.p: Soyuz is a file manager built around one promise: the window never stops responding. Every copy, move, delete, extract or checksum runs as a background job with real progress, pause, resume and cancel, conflict handling, history and undo.

ul.li: Tabs, dual panes and workspaces, all driven from the keyboard and a command palette
Background jobs with undo; deletes go to the trash first
Previews for images, text, code, audio and archives, plus Quick Look
Streaming search, folder sizes, a treemap, duplicate finder and folder compare
Browse and create zip, tar and 7z archives
An embedded terminal and remote locations over SFTP, WebDAV, FTP and S3
One TOML file configures everything, editable from the Settings window

screenshot.caption: A folder in details view with the preview pane
Dual pane with a folder comparison
A copy job running in the activity panel

description.p: Fixes to the test suite on Linux and Windows; the app itself is unchanged from 0.3.1.
The assistant's folder scope accepts paths written with short (8.3) names or through junctions.
The terminal UI (soyuz --tui) reaches feature parity with the window and gains a screen-reader mode; saves on Windows no longer get lost when another program has the file open.
Stability fixes; About shows the git commit the build comes from.
First public build. Linux packages are new and less tested than the Windows build.
